_note: Savings-account interest — "in case of an assessee mentioned in sub-section (1)(a) or (c), the whole of the interest up to a maximum amount of ₹ 10000 on deposits in a savings account, excluding time deposits" (s.153(2)(a), p.185), for "(a) an individual, not being a senior citizen; or … (c) a Hindu undivided family" whose gross total income "includes income by way of interest on deposits with" a bank, a co-operative bank or a Post Office (s.153(1)); time deposits are "repayable on expiry of fixed periods" (s.153(5)). The deposit-taker and account are the entered kind (OtherSourceKind.SAVINGS_DEPOSIT_INTEREST); a senior citizen takes DED-DEPOSIT-INTEREST-SENIOR instead; an expense entered against the interest is refused (OQ-25). rulebook DED-80TTA-001. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80TTA(1) (thc pp.424–425) — an individual or HUF "(other than the assessee referred to in section 80TTB)", interest "(not being time deposits) in a savings account", "ten thousand rupees" in the aggregate; its Post Office is the Indian Post Office Act, 1898's, repealed by the Post Office Act, 2023, which changes no figure. sources/2026-10-16-deposit-interest.md. D-195. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (D-166).
